from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
path=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ccdf95c1.py')
path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Move the non-background object next to the full 2-line; mark its far edge."""
    g = [list(row) for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = 4
    # Find the full line (the divider/attractor).
    full_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r])) == 1 and g[r][0] != bg]
    full_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == g[0][c] and g[0][c] != bg for r in range(h))]
    if full_rows:
        r = full_rows[0]
        color = g[r][0]
        cells = [(i, j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] != bg and i != r]
        if not cells:
            return g
        minr, maxr = min(i for i,j in cells), max(i for i,j in cells)
        minc, maxc = min(j for i,j in cells), max(j for i,j in cells)
        # Clear the object, then translate it until its nearest edge touches the line.
        obj = [(i, j, g[i][j]) for i,j in cells]
        for i,j,_ in obj:
            g[i][j] = bg
        if minr > r:  # object below the divider
            dr = r + 1 - minr
            mark_r = r + 1 + (maxr-minr) + 1
        else:  # object above the divider
            dr = r - 1 - maxr
            mark_r = r - 1 - (maxr-minr) - 1
        for i,j,v in obj:
            g[i+dr][j] = v
        if 0 <= mark_r < h:
            g[mark_r] = [10-color] * w
        return g
    if full_cols:
        c = full_cols[0]
        color = g[0][c]
        cells = [(i, j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] != bg and j != c]
        if not cells:
            return g
        minr, maxr = min(i for i,j in cells), max(i for i,j in cells)
        minc, maxc = min(j for i,j in cells), max(j for i,j in cells)
        obj = [(i, j, g[i][j]) for i,j in cells]
        for i,j,_ in obj:
            g[i][j] = bg
        if minc > c:  # object to the right
            dc = c + 1 - minc
            mark_c = c + 1 + (maxc-minc) + 1
        else:  # object to the left
            dc = c - 1 - maxc
            mark_c = c - 1 - (maxc-minc) - 1
        for i,j,v in obj:
            g[i][j+dc] = v
        if 0 <= mark_c < w:
            for i in range(h):
                g[i][mark_c] = 10-color
        return g
    return g
'''
